messages.subject: Problem importing Actigraph CSV. file
parts:
Hi,

I got some problem when importing my Actigraph CSV. file to R studio to run the GGIR. I keep getting the error message which is: "Error in if (sf == 0) sf = 80 : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed". 

Any suggestion would be greatly appreciated!

Thanks,
Anjo

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Problem importing Actigraph CSV. file
parts:
Hi Anjo,
Looks like GGIR struggles to find the sampling frequency in the file header.
Can you create an issue on https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/issues with the same question, but expanded with a snapshot of the file header? (attaching the first 100 lines of the files as attachment is also fine).
Best, Vincent
